help.title: Location not showing?
help.intro: Ask the owner to follow these steps:
steps: Check that sharing via Kenwa is active and the phone mode is set to "High accuracy."
Give Kenwa full location access and allow "Precise location."
Restart the app or phone to acquire a fresh GPS or location-service fix.
Try outside or near a window for better satellite reception.
help.outro: Let them know when you are ready so the owner can send the update again.

help.title: Help & support
help.intro: Here you will find the steps to enable your location per device and how to view Kenwa in another language. Choose the instructions for your device and follow them step by step.

ios.title: iPhone (iOS 16/17)
steps: Open Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services.
Turn Location Services on at the top.
Scroll down, choose your browser (Safari/Chrome) or the Kenwa app, and set Allow Location Access to While Using the App.
Enable Precise Location for an exact GPS fix.
Reopen Kenwa and press Update location.

android.title: Android (Samsung, Pixel, Xiaomi)
steps: Swipe down and make sure the Location / GPS quick toggle is switched on.
Go to Settings > Location and turn the switch on.
Choose Location accuracy or Google Location Accuracy and enable high accuracy.
Open App permissions, find your browser or the Kenwa app, and choose Allow all the time or Allow only while using the app.
Return to Kenwa and send another update.

desktop.title: Desktop browser (Chrome/Edge/Firefox)
steps: Ensure your laptop supports GPS/location services (wifi + Bluetooth improve accuracy).
Click the padlock in the address bar and choose Site settings.
Set Location to Allow.
Reload the page and choose Allow in the pop-up.
Use the Update location button in the Kenwa dashboard.

troubleshoot.title: Location still not working?
items: Check that your device has internet (wifi or mobile).
Restart the phone or browser to obtain a fresh GPS fix.
Try outside or near a window for better satellite reception.
Remove outdated share codes and generate a new one in your dashboard.
Test manually: send a POST to /api/locations/live with fresh coordinates and your token.
Still stuck? Reach out via {{contact}} and include device + browser details.

languages.title: Website in another language
steps: Choose a language in the top-right corner and select Dutch or English.
The page reloads with the selected language.
Want to switch back? Select Dutch again.
languages.note: We keep improving our translations. Spot an error? Let us know via Contact.

items.question: How do I start sharing my live location?
items.answer: Open the Live location streaming page, tap Start and choose Allow in the browser prompt. Keep GPS enabled and the screen awake for the most reliable updates.

items.question: Why must the site run over HTTPS?
items.answer: Location data is sensitive. We require a secure https:// connection so your position stays encrypted while it is sent to our servers.

items.question: How do I share my follow code with others?
items.answer: Sign in to the dashboard, copy the follow code under Your follow code and send it via email or chat to followers. They enter the code on the Follow page.

items.question: What if GPS cannot get a signal?
items.answer: Ensure Location/GPS is set to high accuracy, move outside or near a window, and restart the phone if needed. Then repeat the troubleshooting steps in the section below.

aboutPage.title: Why I built Kenwa
intro: I often saw stories about people who run into danger on the street, on holiday or while travelling. In those moments every minute counts.
Family and friends want to know immediately where someone is. Without the right tool that costs time and causes stress. With Kenwa you can share your location faster so help or reassurance is closer.
Kenwa offers peace of mind for everyone who watches along and for the person on the move. The platform is built to be simple, reliable and accessible.
pillars: Safety first: shared locations are encrypted and you decide who can follow you.
Calm for families: with a live map you no longer need to call around when someone is delayed.
Privacy by default: no hidden trackers or data sales.
